notes.title: # Version Update v0.1133
notes.content: [p]1. Adjusted the Boss resurrection mechanism: the resurrection time has been shortened from 30 minutes to 10 minutes to improve challenge efficiency.[/p][p]2. Optimized the new player experience: Reduced the HP and defense of "Qi Gathering" monsters in the Novice Village to ease initial combat pressure.[/p][p]3. Welfare adjustment: Increased the number of spirit beast eggs given by Senior Sister of Yushou Peak to 4, helping players with early-stage development.[/p][p]4. Map optimization: Adjusted the battle map of the Boss in the "Yukong Flight" quest to optimize the battle scene experience.[/p][p]5. Mall adjustment: Reduced the price of skill books to make it easier for players to obtain key skills.[/p][p]6. Detailed optimization: User experience upgrades.[/p]

notes.title: Free Trial Version -
notes.content: [p]Dear Cultivators, thanks for your patience! The <Cultivation Magic World> Demo will officially launch at 8:00 PM ET (Eastern Time) on August 22, 2025![/p][p]We welcome you all to download and experience it. Should you have any suggestions, please feel free to share them with us.[/p][p]Your journey of cultivation begins now—we look forward to meeting you in the immortal realm![/p]
